wallet <- 25
while (wallet <= 0) {
  dice <- sample(1:6, 3, replace = TRUE)
  
  if ((dice[1] != dice[2]) &&
      (dice[1] != dice[3]) && (dice[2] != dice[3])) {
    wallet = wallet + 1##winning
  } else {
    #losing
    wallet = wallet - 2
  }
}


wallet <- 25
round_conter = 1
  while(round_counter <= 10 || wallet < 30){
    dice <- sample(1:6, 3, replace = TRUE)
    if (length(unique(dice)) == length(dice)){
    wallet = wallet + 1
  } else {
    wallet = wallet - 2
  }

round_conter = 1
  for(round_counter in 1:3){
    dice <- sample(1:6, 3, replace = TRUE)
    if (length(unique(dice)) == length(dice)){
    wallet = wallet + 1
  } else {
    wallet = wallet - 2
  }
print(round_counter)
}

##change all even numbers in vec to zero
numbers <- sample(1:100, 100)

## way 1
for(i in 1:length(numbers)){
  if (numbers[i] %% 2 == 0){
    numbers[i] <- 0
  }
  print(numbers)
}

##way 2
new_numbers <- ifelse(numbers %% 2 == 0, 0, numbers)

##way 3
numbers[numbers %% 2 == 0] = 0

vec = 1:5
var(vec)
my_sum = 0
for (my_number in vec){
my_sum<- my_sum + my_number
}
print(my_sum)

##iterate over the elements 
for (literal_element in vec){
  print(literal_element)
}
##iterate over the positions
for(literal_position in 1:length(vec)){
  print(vec[literal_position])
}

m = matrix(sample(1:7, 100, replace = T), nrow = 25, ncol = 4)
colnames(m) = c("racism", "drift_rate", "racial_attitude", "insincerity_of_smile")
df = as.data.frame(m)

##compute total racism score 
racism_score = c()
for (row in 1:nrow(df)){
  ind_score = df$racism[row] +df$racial_attitude[row]
  racism_score = c(racism_score, ind_score)
}

##which order are things printed?
for(number in c(1,2,3)){
  for(letter in c("A", "B", "C")){
    print(c(number,letter))
  }
}

##implicit loops
##for racism e.g., sum all 4 variables for each participant
for (i in 1:nrow(df)){
  print(sum(df[i,]))
}
##simpler ways
apply(df, 1, sum)

sapply(df$racism, sqrt)

judge_person = function(ai_picture){
  
  if(!is.logical(ai_picture)){
    stop("ai picture should be logical!!")
  }
  
  if(ai_picture){
     return("swipe no") 
  } else {
    return("swipe yes")
  }
}

judge_person(ai_picture = "yes")
